items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Lovie Joe was the star of the song... Lovie Joe was supposed to have been an old-time Mack Man... He said, 'That's Lovie Joe.'

ctx.x: say "Lovie Joe. That's the great Lovie Joe." Lovie Joe was the star of the song that got(?) "Stop It, Joe." It's an old risqué tune that all the performers used to do. And Lovie Joe was supposed to have been an old-time Mack Man, an old-time pimp. Now, this is an old man, dark, with real keen features, and he looked like he's got blue eyes. Strange looking. And he's always on 135th Street, going into one bar, into another one, always dressed immaculate. He was about as big as me, slim, and... He said, "That's…
That's the kind of cat Steele(?) was. He knew everybody, he'd get gigs, and call me on a gig, and we'd always meet and...
